novel.justification: For every fixed marginal pair, minimality of \(S^\star\) implies \(h_{\mu}(T)<c\) for every \(T\prec S^\star\); since \(2^E\) is finite, some positive common predecessor gap therefore exists automatically. For a fixed prescribed \(\eta>0\), the condition excludes points whose minimum predecessor slack is below \(\eta\), generally positive-width neighborhoods of predecessor feasibility surfaces; it remains directly checkable from the identified marginals.
